Human activity looks all the more mundane when seen from such a distance. This wide shot helps us recalibrate: if we can’t reach these men by any means, there’s no point in trying to understand their actions. And even if they think they can be the sand in the gears, the pristine bigger picture proves they (we?) are nothing but grains of sand.

Elias is trying so hard to establish eye contact that he even looks into the lens, but there’s not a thin crack in the fourth wall. As he narrates something hard to believe, he dares to remind us this is all a construction.
